hub.title: Games with the ghosts | Omon Omon
hub.heading: Games with the ghosts
hub.description: Play short mini-games with four Indonesian ghosts. Earn candles, grow your bond with each ghost and unlock more of their stories.
hub.intro: Each ghost has her own little game. Play to earn candles and grow your bond with her.

games.title: Hop Hop
games.description: Help {name}, the pocong who can only hop, jump over tombstones in this one-button endless runner. How far can you get?

how.en: Tap, click or press Space to hop.
how.id: Ketuk, klik, atau tekan Spasi untuk melompat.

en: That was short. Even the dead last longer.
id: Pendek banget. Orang mati aja lebih awet.

en: You hop like you mean it. Almost.
Fine. That was good. Don't let it go to your head.
Impressive. For someone who still has legs.
id: Hebat. Buat yang masih punya kaki.

en: A new record. I'm almost happy.
Your best yet. Do not tell anyone I said so.
id: Terbaikmu sejauh ini. Jangan bilang siapa-siapa.

games.title: Night Rounds
games.tagline: answer the lights before they run out
games.description: Help {name} on her night shift: tap the rooms that light up before their timers run out.

games.title: Quiet Wish
games.description: A slow, calm memory game with {name}: repeat the glowing petals. No timer, no pressure.

games.title: Hair Catch
games.description: Move left and right to help {name} catch falling secrets with her hair, and dodge the duds.
